original.bodyScope: Exact c12a original architecture generator body. Relative imports are rebased to the current project modules; city data, frontage detail and palette remain shared. This comparison isolates the subsequent pane geometry and spatial/material batching changes, not unrelated historical 3.15 visual differences.

checks.name: Every original instance survives; non-pane shapes retain exact geometry, transform, tint, material and detail tier
Every outward glass vertex, normal, metre UV, tint, emission, reflection parameter and LOD matches the retained generator
checks.scope: Comparison uses the actual Float32 instance matrices; front planes differ only by sub-0.1 mm transform rounding. Hidden side/back faces in solid sealed recesses are removed; full freestanding clerestory boxes are retained.

checks.name: The actual glass shader carries instance response through the inherited exterior hooks and preserves scene-versus-explicit environment selection
checks.scope: Source hook and material state checks only; actual GPU link/draw validation is separate.

scope: The full 15-view budget is separately checked against unchanged 3.5 thresholds. This independent representation-preservation test cannot replace final source-bound GPU frames, validate hidden geometry from an impossible position inside a closed building, or measure hardware performance.
